All modules

timeline

pages · 0.6.0 · aj-p-timeline

Timeline: the journal by day, newest first (day rows, recordings, the month headings), with the date and mood card (its mood panel and calendar) and the search as the list's running head (v4 C1). Below 1200 the card sits above the search; on desktop it is the sticky column right of the list.

variantplatformmobile · tablet · desktop (default mobile)
variantstatelist · mood · calendar · mood-one-day · mood-empty-week · found · no-matches · searching · search-failed · earlier · end · thin-week · loading (default list)
variantcontextscreen · walkthrough (default screen)
contentdatadata
statedefaultyes: the list, both card parts closed
statehovern/a: a page; its controls carry their own
statefocus-visiblen/a: a page; its controls carry their own
stateactiven/a: a page; its controls carry their own
statedisabledn/a: a page; its controls carry their own
stateselectedyes: mood (the card's panel open)
stateloadingyes: timeline-loading, the list's skeleton (four days and a memo, as the record draws them) under the real find bar and card; "Loading your days." announced; no foot
stateerroryes: search-failed
stateemptyyes: mood-empty-week; no-matches; earlier and end change the foot line; thin-week is a few days
